# Mini Challenge: Image Classifier

import numpy as np
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from tensorflow.keras.datasets import fashion_mnist
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

print("=== Mini Challenge: Build an Image Classifier ===\n")

print("""
Your task: Build a CNN to classify Fashion MNIST images.

Dataset: 10 classes of fashion items
  - T-shirt/top, Trouser, Pullover, Dress, Coat
  - Sandal, Shirt, Sneaker, Bag, Ankle boot

Requirements:
  1. CNN architecture
  2. Data augmentation
  3. Dropout regularization
  4. Early stopping
  5. Achieve > 90% test accuracy
""")

print("=== Loading Fashion MNIST ===\n")

# Load data
(X_train, y_train), (X_test, y_test) = fashion_mnist.load_data()

class_names = ['T-shirt/top', 'Trouser', 'Pullover', 'Dress', 'Coat',
               'Sandal', 'Shirt', 'Sneaker', 'Bag', 'Ankle boot']

print(f"Training: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"Test: {X_test.shape}")
print(f"Classes: {class_names}")

# Display sample
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 5, figsize=(12, 5))
for i in range(10):
    row = i // 5
    col = i % 5
    axes[row, col].imshow(X_train[i], cmap='gray')
    axes[row, col].set_title(class_names[y_train[i]])
    axes[row, col].axis('off')
plt.suptitle('Fashion MNIST Samples')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

print("\n=== Preprocessing ===\n")

# Preprocess
X_train = X_train.reshape(-1, 28, 28, 1).astype('float32') / 255.0
X_test = X_test.reshape(-1, 28, 28, 1).astype('float32') / 255.0

# One-hot encode
y_train_onehot = keras.utils.to_categorical(y_train, 10)
y_test_onehot = keras.utils.to_categorical(y_test, 10)

print("Data preprocessed!")

print("\n=== Building CNN ===\n")

# Your CNN here
model = keras.Sequential([
    # First conv block
    layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', padding='same', input_shape=(28, 28, 1)),
    layers.Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
    layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
    layers.Dropout(0.25),
    
    # Second conv block
    layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu', padding='same'),
    layers.Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu'),
    layers.MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),
    layers.Dropout(0.25),
    
    # Dense layers
    layers.Flatten(),
    layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
    layers.Dropout(0.5),
    layers.Dense(10, activation='softmax')
])

print(f"Model summary:")
model.summary()

print("\n=== Compiling and Training ===\n")

model.compile(
    optimizer='adam',
    loss='categorical_crossentropy',
    metrics=['accuracy']
)

# Callbacks
early_stopping = keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor='val_accuracy',
    patience=5,
    restore_best_weights=True
)

# Train
history = model.fit(
    X_train, y_train_onehot,
    epochs=20,
    batch_size=128,
    validation_split=0.2,
    callbacks=[early_stopping],
    verbose=0
)

print(f"Training accuracy: {history.history['accuracy'][-1]:.4f}")
print(f"Validation accuracy: {history.history['val_accuracy'][-1]:.4f}")

print("\n=== Evaluating on Test Set ===\n")

test_loss, test_acc = model.evaluate(X_test, y_test_onehot, verbose=0)
print(f"Test accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}")

if test_acc > 0.9:
    print("🎉 Congratulations! You achieved > 90% accuracy!")
else:
    print(f"📈 Close! Need > 90%. Current: {test_acc:.4f}")
    print("Try adding more layers or adjusting hyperparameters.")

print("\n=== Challenge Complete! ===\n")

print("""
✅ You've built a Fashion MNIST classifier!
✅ CNN architecture
✅ Data preprocessing
✅ Training and evaluation
✅ Achieved good performance

Next steps:
  - Try data augmentation
  - Try transfer learning
  - Experiment with architectures
  - Deploy your model
""")
